author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.63 shipped: EV fill-priority re-pause buffer
why: Mid-peak SOC hovering at the 80% fill-priority threshold toggled EVSE/plugs by tenths. Chose a 3-point re-pause band held in a RAM latch that stores its threshold, over a time debounce (time x state-machine seams are our worst bug family) and over a persisted latch (one extra pause after restart is harmless). Constant, not a knob: the band is a protocol window. Tier 3 elevated by operator as sensitive code. Review A caught A-HIGH-1: my own plan ruling put proactive off-peak holds in the peer-steal list, which would clear the latch every off-peak tick; B confirmed independently; C mutated 47 sites all red; D found no invariant break. Orchestrator drill re-adding off-peak to the steal list reddened its test. Name-diff clean 119/15013. Operator go 2026-10-15; activates at the 10-16 daytime restart alongside v5.103.62.
implications: Shipped EV-FILL-PRIORITY-SOC-CHATTER-1 at v5.103.63; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.63.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: recorder history of EVSE/plug fill-priority pause switches during the first mid-peak window with Envoy SOC between 77 and 80 after restart: at most one resume and zero re-pauses while SOC >= 77

refs.release_notes: After fill priority resumes an EV charger or plug at the threshold, it is not re-paused until SOC drops 3 points below it, ending mid-peak toggle chatter. Tier 3, four reviews.
